observations.notes: FY25 assets NGN 51.56tn (+24.2% YoY), loans NGN 13.34tn, deposits NGN 34.56tn (+53.4% YoY), PBT NGN 1.01tn, PAT NGN 743.05bn, equity NGN 4.33tn.

9M26 PBT NGN 667.4bn (+8.3% YoY), PAT NGN 474.2bn (+5.9% YoY). Impairment charges plunged 73.5% YoY to NGN 92.9bn (CoR 0.9% vs 3.8%). Assets NGN 52.6tn, loans NGN 14.3tn, deposits NGN 36.8tn, equity NGN 4.5tn; CAR ~17.4% (Fitch).

verdict.stance: Neutral / Nigeria Banking Scale Anchor Post-2026 Bond Payoff
verdict.summary: Nigeria's largest banking group by assets (NGN 52.6tn at 3Q26) proved FC liquidity resilience by redeeming its $500m 6.125% Sep-2026 Eurobond in full from internal FX resources and satisfying CBN's NGN 500bn recapitalization mandate. 9M26 PAT rose 5.9% to NGN 474.2bn as provisions plunged 73.5%, though tight ~17.4% CAR buffer over the 15% floor bears watching.

positives: Proven hard-currency liquidity: Redeemed $500m 6.125% Sep-2026 senior Eurobond in full from internal FC liquidity.
Sharp asset-quality normalization in 9M26: Credit impairment fell 73.5% YoY to NGN 92.9bn (CoR 0.9% vs 3.8%).
Met CBN NGN 500bn minimum capital threshold via NGN 351bn rights issue + private placements; dominant NGN 36.8tn deposit base.
negatives: Tight CAR headroom (~17.4% vs 15% regulatory minimum) noted by Fitch alongside post-forbearance sector risks.
NII margin squeeze: 9M26 interest expense +10.1% YoY (NGN 1.81tn) capped NII growth at +2.7%.
Nigerian sovereign/FX ceiling ('B' Fitch) and pan-African M&A integration risk.

background.business_overview: Nigeria's largest bank by assets (NGN 52.6tn) with corporate, retail, and pan-African/UK international banking subsidiaries.
background.asset_perimeter: Access Bank Nigeria plus UK subsidiary and pan-African operations across >15 countries.
background.ownership_governance: NGX-listed Access Holdings Plc; regulated by Central Bank of Nigeria.

Sep-26 Debt Milestone: Redeemed $500m 6.125% Senior Eurobond at maturity using internal FC liquidity; Oct AT1 call window in focus.

historical_notes.title: Coverage Initiated: Access Holdings 9M 2026 & $500m Sep-26 Eurobond Redemption
historical_notes.summary: Added Access Holdings (ACCESS, B Fitch). 9M26 PAT NGN 474.2bn (+5.9% YoY), Assets NGN 52.6tn, Loans NGN 14.3tn, Deposits NGN 36.8tn, Equity NGN 4.5tn. Redeemed $500m 6.125% Eurobond in Sep-26.

annotations.note: Access Bank paid off its $500m 6.125% Sep-2026 senior Eurobond in full at maturity from internal FC liquidity without issuing a replacement.
Fulfilled CBN's NGN 500bn international bank capital floor via NGN 351bn rights issue and private placements.
